audience.title: Built for planner creators
audience.subtitle: Whether you sell on Etsy or design for yourself — if you already have the artwork, Dyna handles the dates.

cards.title: Etsy & digital sellers
cards.pain: A yearly planner means 365 pages to duplicate and date by hand.
cards.solution: Generate a full dated PDF from one template and ship faster.

cards.title: Canva & Photoshop designers
cards.pain: Fixed templates kill your style; manual spreads eat your weekends.
cards.solution: Keep your exact layout — just mark where dates go on the canvas.

cards.title: Personal & print projects
cards.pain: Reordering pages when the calendar shifts is tedious and error-prone.
cards.solution: Pick a date range and let Dyna order weeks, months and days correctly.

benefits.title: What you get with Dyna
